neighbours.label: a reporting or seeking verb or purpose adverb in informational prose (police are searching, the mayor stated, principally for), versus the same sentences with a plain action verb
fire: State troopers are searching for a hiker who went missing near the ridge.
After the vote, the mayor stated that taxes would not rise.
The catalog features rugs and lamps, principally for bedrooms.
Chicken thighs should attain a temperature of 165 degrees before serving.
Rescue crews are searching for survivors under the collapsed bridge.
Over two hundred families attended, the organizer stated proudly.
Visit our website to get more information about flu shots.
The study was funded principally by a private foundation.
quiet: State troopers rescued a hiker who went missing near the ridge.
After the vote, the mayor smiled and left the hall.
The catalog features rugs and lamps for every room.
Chicken thighs should rest for five minutes before serving.
Rescue crews pulled survivors from under the collapsed bridge.
Over two hundred families attended the picnic by the lake.
Visit our website to book a flu shot this week.
The study was funded by a private foundation in Ohio.
